title: How to Configure Corporate VPN
content: To set up the corporate VPN on your device, navigate to your operating system's Network Settings. Select 'Add VPN Connection'. Choose 'L2TP/IPsec with pre-shared key' as the connection type. Enter the server address 'vpn.globalcorp.com' and use your active directory credentials to authenticate.

title: Office Working Hours and Access Policy
content: Our main office is open for all employees from Monday to Friday, between 08:00 AM and 08:00 PM. Access outside these hours, including weekends and public holidays, requires prior approval from your direct manager and security team via the building access portal.

title: Requesting Annual Paid Leave
content: Employees are entitled to 25 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. To request time off, log into the HR portal, go to 'Time Off Tracker', select your dates, and submit the request. Ensure you submit it at least two weeks in advance for approval.

title: Wi-Fi Network Access in the Office
content: The secure office Wi-Fi network is 'GlobalCorp-Secure'. To connect, select the network on your device, enter your corporate email address as the username, and enter your current system password. Guest network 'GlobalCorp-Guest' is for visitors only.

title: How to Reset Your Active Directory Password
content: If you are locked out of your account, visit the Self-Service Password Reset portal at reset.globalcorp.com. You will need to verify your identity using the Microsoft Authenticator app on your registered mobile device before choosing a new password.

title: Corporate Laptop Replacement Policy
content: Standard corporate laptops are scheduled for hardware replacement every 36 months. If your laptop is experiencing severe hardware degradation or is close to its lifecycle end, open an IT ticket under the 'Hardware Request' category to schedule an upgrade.

title: Booking a Meeting Room via Outlook
content: To book a meeting room, open your Outlook Calendar and create a new meeting event. Click on the 'Required' or 'Location' field and search for rooms using the prefix 'MR-'. Select an available room that matches your team size and send the invite.

title: Submitting Business Travel Expenses
content: All travel expenses must be submitted through the Concur platform within 30 days of returning from a trip. You must attach scanned copies of itemized receipts for any transaction exceeding $25. Alcohol purchases are not reimbursable under company policy.

title: Health and Medical Insurance Overview
content: Our comprehensive health insurance covers dental, vision, general practice, and specialized surgery. The primary provider is BlueShield. You can download your digital insurance card and view coverage limits on the employee benefits portal under 'My Health'.

title: Emergency Evacuation Procedures
content: In the event of a fire or emergency alarm, immediately stop working, leave your belongings, and walk calmly to the nearest marked exit door. Do not use the elevators under any circumstances. Assemble at the designated muster point in the north parking lot.

title: Requesting a Software License
content: To request non-standard software licenses (e.g., Adobe Creative Cloud, JetBrains, Figma), submit a request form on the IT service catalog. Your request must include a business justification and approval from your department head for budget allocation.

title: Reporting Security Incidents and Phishing
content: If you receive a suspicious email, do not click any links or download attachments. Click the 'Report Phishing' button in Outlook. For urgent security incidents, such as lost laptops or compromised badges, call the SOC hotline immediately at ext. 9111.

title: Standard Git Branching Strategy
content: Our engineering teams follow GitFlow. The 'main' branch contains production-ready code. The 'develop' branch is where integration happens. All new features must be developed on a 'feature/...' branch branched from 'develop' and merged via Pull Request.

title: Sick Leave Notification Policy
content: If you are unable to work due to illness, you must notify your manager via Slack or email by 09:00 AM on the first day of absence. If your sickness lasts more than three consecutive business days, a doctor's note must be uploaded to the HR portal.

title: Accessing the Jira Project Board
content: All project tasks are tracked in Jira. To access your team's board, go to jira.globalcorp.com and search for your project key. If you need edit permissions or access to a new board, request your project manager to add you to the project's users group.

title: Standard Code Review Guidelines
content: Every Pull Request requires at least two approvals from senior engineers before merging into 'develop'. Reviewers must check for architectural consistency, security vulnerabilities, unit test coverage (minimum 80%), and adherence to clean code principles.

title: Confluence Documentation Standards
content: When creating project documentation in Confluence, always use the standard 'Product Requirements' or 'Technical Design' templates. Ensure you tag relevant team members, set a page owner, and update the status of the document regularly.

title: Working from Home (WFH) Equipment Allowance
content: Full-time employees working in a hybrid model are eligible for a one-time remote work setup stipend of $500. This budget can be used to purchase ergonomic office chairs, external monitors, keyboards, or mice. Submit receipts in the HR portal under 'WFH Allowance'.

title: Accessing Paystubs and Tax Documents
content: Your monthly paystubs, annual tax forms (W-2 or local equivalent), and compensation details are hosted securely on ADP Workforce. Log in using your work email address and password. Paystubs are published on the 25th of every month.

title: Data Classification and Handling Policy
content: Information at GlobalCorp is classified into four categories: Public, Internal, Confidential, and Restricted. Confidential data must always be encrypted at rest and in transit and must never be shared externally without a signed Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA).

title: Setting Up Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
content: Two-Factor Authentication is mandatory for all corporate accounts. Install the Microsoft Authenticator app on your phone. Go to security.globalcorp.com, click 'Add sign-in method', select 'Authenticator app', and scan the QR code displayed on your monitor.

title: Employee Referral Program Bonus
content: We encourage employees to refer talented individuals. If your referral is hired for a full-time position and completes their 3-month probation period, you will receive a $1,500 referral bonus in your next paycheck. Submit referrals via the Careers page.

title: Internal Job Posting and Transfer Policy
content: Employees who have been in their current role for at least 12 months are eligible to apply for internal open positions. Browse vacant roles on the internal job board. You must inform your current manager before accepting an offer for an internal transfer.

title: Using the Office Printers
content: Printers are configured on the print server. To connect, search for '\\print-server' in Windows Explorer and double-click the printer closest to your desk. To release your prints, tap your physical employee badge on the card reader on top of the printer.

title: Corporate Gym Membership Discount
content: We partner with Gold's Gym and ActiveLife to offer employees a 40% discount on annual memberships. To activate the corporate rate, present your physical company ID badge at the reception of any participating location or use the discount code 'GC-HEALTH'.

title: Ordering Office Supplies
content: Standard office supplies such as notebooks, pens, sticky notes, and whiteboard markers are available in the storage cabinets on each floor. For specialized requests (e.g., customized notebooks or specific ergonomics), contact the Office Manager via email.

title: Parental Leave Policy Guidelines
content: GlobalCorp offers 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave to all new parents (both birth and adoptive parents) within the first year of the child's birth or placement. Submit your parental leave request to HR at least 60 days before your intended start date.

title: Code of Conduct and Anti-Harassment
content: We are committed to a diverse, inclusive, and safe workplace. Discrimination or harassment of any kind based on race, gender, religion, sexual orientation, or disability is strictly prohibited. Violations will result in disciplinary action up to termination.

title: Managing Your AWS Sandbox Account
content: Engineers can request an AWS sandbox account for experimentation. Sandbox accounts have a monthly spending limit of $100. Any resources created must be tagged with your username, and unused instances must be terminated at the end of each work week.

title: Creating an Expense Report on Mobile
content: To submit expenses on the go, download the SAP Concur app from the App Store or Google Play. Log in using Single Sign-On (SSO). You can snap photos of receipts with your phone camera, and the app will automatically parse the price, date, and vendor.

title: Professional Development Training Budget
content: Each employee is allocated an annual training budget of $1,000 for courses, certifications, and conferences. To use this budget, get approval from your manager first, purchase the course, and then submit a reimbursement claim under 'Professional Development'.

title: How to Join the Weekly Town Hall
content: The global company Town Hall takes place every Thursday at 04:00 PM EST. The meeting is broadcast live via Zoom. The link is pinned in the #announcements Slack channel. Slido is used to collect questions anonymously prior to and during the live session.

title: Customer Data Privacy and GDPR Compliance
content: As part of our commitment to GDPR, customer personal identifiable information (PII) must never be extracted from production databases into local environments or spreadsheets. Any request to export customer data must be approved by the Data Protection Officer.

title: Submitting a Support Ticket to IT Helpdesk
content: For technical issues with your computer, account access, or desk equipment, submit a ticket at helpdesk.globalcorp.com. Provide a descriptive title, steps to reproduce the issue, and screenshots of any error messages to help IT resolve it faster.

title: Getting Help with Workplace Ergonomics
content: If you experience physical discomfort while working at your desk, you can request an ergonomic assessment. An HR representative or qualified occupational therapist will evaluate your posture, chair height, and monitor placement, and recommend adjustments.

title: Annual Performance Review Cycle
content: The annual performance review occurs between October and December. It consists of three phases: self-evaluation, peer reviews, and manager evaluation. This cycle determines promotions, performance ratings, and salary adjustments for the next fiscal year.

title: Intellectual Property (IP) Protection
content: All code, designs, documentation, and ideas created by employees during their employment at GlobalCorp are the exclusive intellectual property of the company. Sharing proprietary code on personal public GitHub repositories is a violation of your contract.

title: Slack Workspace Best Practices
content: Use public channels instead of direct messages whenever discussing project details to ensure transparency. Set your status to 'Away' or 'OOO' when offline or on vacation. Use threads to reply to specific messages and keep channels clean and organized.

title: Ordering Lunch via Corporate Catering
content: The company provides catered lunch on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Meals must be ordered by 05:00 PM on the preceding day using the LunchBot application in Slack. Vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free, and kosher options are available upon request.

title: How to Set Up Out of Office (OOO) Auto-Reply
content: Before going on leave, configure an auto-reply in Outlook. Go to File -> Automatic Replies. Write a clear message indicating the dates you will be away, who to contact in your absence for urgent matters, and when you plan to respond to emails.

title: Understanding Your Stock Options (ESOP)
content: Eligible employees receive stock options under our Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP). Options vest over a 4-year period with a 1-year cliff. You can view your grant details, vesting schedule, and execute options on the EquityGate platform.

title: Accessing the Software Architecture Review Board
content: Before introducing new frameworks, major architectural patterns, or third-party cloud services, engineers must present a design document to the Architecture Review Board (ARB). Meetings are held bi-weekly on Wednesdays. Submit proposals in Confluence.

title: Company Credit Card Usage Rules
content: Corporate credit cards are issued to department heads and frequent business travelers. They must only be used for approved business expenses, such as client entertainment, travel, and software tools. Personal purchases are strictly prohibited and audited monthly.

title: Using the Guest Wi-Fi Network
content: Visitors can access the 'GlobalCorp-Guest' network. After selecting the network, a captive portal page will appear. The visitor must enter their name, phone number, and the email of their company host. A temporary 8-hour password will be sent via SMS.

title: Mental Health and Counseling Services (EAP)
content: Our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offers free, confidential counseling sessions for personal or work-related challenges. Services are available 24/7. Call the toll-free number 1-800-555-HELP or schedule a virtual appointment with a therapist online.

title: Disposal of Confidential Physical Documents
content: Do not throw paper documents containing confidential client information, passwords, or financial figures in standard trash bins. Place them in the locked gray shredding bins located near the printing stations. These bins are securely emptied and shredded weekly.

title: Corporate Brand Guidelines and Assets
content: When designing external presentations, proposals, or social media posts, you must follow the official corporate brand guidelines. The brand book, logo assets, authorized color palettes, and presentation templates are available on the Brand Drive.

title: Requesting a New Slack Channel
content: To request a new Slack channel, run the `/request-channel` command in Slack. Specify the channel name, a clear description of its purpose, whether it should be public or private, and get approval from your team's designated Slack administrator.

title: Accessing and Submitting Time Sheets
content: Contractors and hourly employees must submit weekly timesheets in the Kronos system. Timesheets must be finalized and submitted by 05:00 PM every Friday. Managers must review and approve timesheets by Monday noon to ensure timely payroll processing.

title: Standard Onboarding Process for New Hires
content: All new hires must complete the interactive onboarding course within their first week. This includes watching the CEO welcome video, completing cybersecurity awareness training, setting up their payroll account, and scheduling a 1-on-1 with their team buddy.

title: IT Service Desk Walk-in Hours
content: For immediate physical computer assistance (e.g., broken screens, missing chargers), visit the IT Helpdesk bar located on the 3rd floor. Walk-in hours are Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM and 02:00 PM to 04:00 PM. No appointment needed.

title: Continuous Integration (CI) Pipeline Configuration
content: We use GitHub Actions for continuous integration. All repositories must contain a `.github/workflows/ci.yml` file. This workflow must execute linter checks, run unit tests, and build a Docker image. Merging to develop is blocked if the CI pipeline fails.

title: Sponsorship of Employee Visas
content: GlobalCorp supports international talent by sponsoring work visas and green cards. Relocation and sponsorship cases are handled on an individual basis by the Global Mobility Team. To initiate a visa review, discuss with your HR business partner first.

title: How to Claim Mobile Phone Bill Reimbursement
content: Employees whose jobs require constant availability (e.g., on-call engineers, sales representatives) are eligible for a monthly mobile plan reimbursement of up to $50. Submit your itemized monthly phone bill as an expense report under 'Mobile Allowance'.

title: Managing Third-Party Vendors
content: Before onboarding a third-party vendor who will handle company data, you must submit a Vendor Risk Assessment form. The security and legal teams will evaluate the vendor's SOC 2 reports, insurance coverage, and compliance with data safety standards.

title: Configuring IDE Code Formatters
content: To maintain code quality, all engineers must configure their IDEs with the shared EditorConfig. Download the `.editorconfig` file from the repository root. Ensure that your IDE formats on save to eliminate syntax formatting discrepancies in pull requests.

title: Charitable Giving Donation Matching
content: GlobalCorp matches registered employee donations to non-profit organizations dollar-for-dollar up to $500 per employee per year. To request a donation match, submit proof of your donation (receipt) and the charity's details on the Employee Giving portal.

title: Product Launch Communication Protocol
content: Prior to any major public product release, the product manager must complete the Launch Readiness Checklist. This involves coordinating with marketing for press releases, customer success for support documentation, and operations for infrastructure scaling.

title: Accessing Internal Database Servers
content: Direct access to production databases is strictly forbidden. For query and debugging purposes, use the read-only staging databases. To gain database access, submit an access request specifying the database name, tables required, and business reason.

title: Workstation Cleaning and Lock Policy
content: To maintain security and hygiene, you must lock your screen (`Win + L` or `Cmd + Ctrl + Q`) every time you step away from your desk. Do not leave sensitive papers, prototypes, or passwords on sticky notes on your desk when you leave in the evening.

title: Submitting a Patent Idea
content: If you have developed an innovative algorithm, design, or system that could be patentable, contact our Legal IP team. Fill out the Patent Invention Disclosure form. The company will cover all filing costs and offer a monetary reward if the patent is filed.

title: How to Handle Media Inquiries
content: Employees are not authorized to speak to journalists or provide official statements on behalf of GlobalCorp. If you are contacted by a reporter, do not answer any questions. Politely refer them to our Public Relations department at media@globalcorp.com.

title: Software Asset Management Rules
content: Installing unauthorized or pirated software on work computers is a severe security risk and legal violation. All software must be installed via the approved self-service portal (Software Center for Windows or Jamf Self Service for macOS).

title: Office Parking Permits and Spaces
content: Reserved parking spaces under the office building are limited. Annual parking permits are allocated to employees based on seniority and commuting distance. Apply for a parking permit on the facilities portal. Unmarked spaces are first-come, first-served.

title: Peer-to-Peer Recognition (Bonusly)
content: We use Bonusly to celebrate small wins and recognize colleagues. Every employee receives 100 points monthly to give away to peers as recognition. Points can be redeemed for gift cards, charitable donations, or company merchandise.

title: Remote Security Patching and Compliance
content: All company-managed computers run an automated background agent that deploys system security patches. When a critical operating system patch is installed, you will receive a notification to restart your machine within 48 hours. Please do not delay.

title: Incident Management and On-Call Rotations
content: Our engineering teams run 24/7 on-call rotations using PagerDuty. Incidents are categorized by severity. SEV-1 incidents (complete service outage) require the primary responder to acknowledge the alert within 15 minutes and open an incident command bridge.

title: Corporate Hotel Booking Discounts
content: When traveling for business, always book accommodation through our corporate travel agency portal. We have negotiated corporate rates with Marriott, Hilton, and Hyatt hotels globally, which include free high-speed internet and breakfast.

title: Intellectual Diversity and ERG Groups
content: We host several Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) to support diversity, including Women in Tech, Pride-GC, and Multicultural Alliance. These volunteer-led groups organize events, professional panels, and community outreach. Join them via Slack.

title: Standard Desktop Wallpaper Policy
content: To maintain a professional environment during client presentations or screen sharing, employees must use neutral desktop wallpapers. Explicit, political, or offensive images are strictly forbidden. Default corporate brand wallpapers are recommended.

title: Maternity and Pregnancy Workplace Support
content: Pregnant employees are eligible for dedicated desk adjustments, specialized supportive chairs, and priority parking. Our offices feature private, lockable lactation rooms equipped with comfortable seating, power outlets, a refrigerator, and a sink.

title: Accessing and Reviewing OKRs
content: Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) are set quarterly. Company-wide, department-wide, and team-specific OKRs are tracked on the BetterWorks platform. Employees must update their personal progress towards key metrics every two weeks.

title: Creating Custom Email Signatures
content: To maintain brand consistency, all employees must use the standardized email signature format in Outlook. Generate your customized signature block using the template tool at brand.globalcorp.com/signature and paste it into Outlook settings.

title: Managing Sabbatical Leave Eligibility
content: Employees with five or more years of continuous service are eligible to apply for a paid sabbatical. The sabbatical allows for 4 consecutive weeks of paid time off to pursue personal interests, travel, or rest. Plan sabbaticals 6 months in advance with HR.

title: Reporting Workplace Safety Hazards
content: If you notice a safety hazard in the office (e.g., exposed wiring, loose carpets, broken handrails), report it immediately using the Facilities portal. For emergencies involving immediate danger, notify security desk personnel directly.

title: Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Days
content: Every employee receives 2 fully paid Volunteer Time Off (VTO) days per year to participate in volunteer projects with registered non-profits. You can organize team-building volunteer days or complete volunteer work individually. Register VTO on HR portal.

title: Client Entertainment Expense Guidelines
content: Expenses for entertaining current or potential clients require pre-approval if the expected cost exceeds $100 per person. When filing the expense, you must list the names, titles, and company affiliations of all attendees and state the business purpose.

title: Managing Shared Team Calendars
content: Each team should maintain a shared calendar in Google Workspace or Outlook containing vacation dates, training sessions, and key milestones. This ensures high visibility of team availability and avoids scheduling conflicts for major workshops.

title: How to Reset Slack App Cache
content: If Slack is experiencing performance issues, failing to load media, or freezing, try clearing the app cache. In Slack, go to Help -> Troubleshooting -> Clear Cache and Restart. This resolves most loading issues without losing chat history.

title: Submitting Code to open-source Projects
content: Contributing code to external open-source projects using your corporate identity requires approval. Submit a proposal outlining the library, what modifications you want to submit, and the licensing model. The Legal OSS committee will review.

title: Applying for a Corporate Credit Card
content: To apply for a corporate card, download the Corporate Card Request Form, obtain your department head's signature, and submit it to the Treasury team. The physical card will be delivered to your office desk within 5 to 7 business days.

title: Company Vehicle Usage Guidelines
content: Company vehicles are provided for field visits and client transport. Drivers must hold a valid driver's license, have a clean driving record, and undergo an online defensive driving training module before being authorized to book fleet vehicles.

title: Acceptable Use Policy for Social Media
content: When posting on personal social media accounts, make it clear that your opinions are your own and do not represent GlobalCorp. Do not share confidential information, express negative comments about competitors, or post photos showing computer screens.

title: Creating and Sharing Google Drive Folders
content: When creating shared folders in Google Drive, default permissions should be restricted. Do not share folders with 'Anyone with the link' if they contain internal data. Always grant access directly to specific corporate email addresses or groups.

title: Accessing the Corporate Library
content: The company maintains a physical library on the 5th floor containing books on programming, business strategy, marketing, and leadership. To borrow a book, use your mobile app to scan the book's barcode. Books can be kept for up to 30 days.

title: Software Vulnerability Patching SLAs
content: Vulnerabilities discovered in our software code must be remediated based on severity. Critical vulnerabilities must be patched in production within 24 hours. High-severity issues must be patched in 7 days, and medium-severity in 30 days.

title: Pet Policy in the Office
content: Well-behaved dogs are allowed in the office on 'Doggy Fridays' only. Dogs must be kept on a leash in common areas, be fully vaccinated, and be registered on the facilities portal. Owners are fully responsible for cleanup and any disruptions.

title: Employee Relocation Assistance
content: Employees relocated by the company are eligible for relocation assistance. This includes covering the costs of moving companies, temporary housing for up to 30 days, flights to the new location, and a tax-assistance consultation.

title: Accessing Server Performance Logs
content: We use Datadog for system performance monitoring and log aggregation. To access logs, log in with SSO. Filter logs by service name, environment, and trace ID. Never log sensitive fields like passwords or credit card numbers in plain text.

title: Reporting a Workplace Injury
content: If you are injured while at the office or traveling on business, notify your manager and the HR Safety team immediately. Complete the Incident Report form within 24 hours of the occurrence to ensure coverage under worker's compensation insurance.

title: Using the Company Zoom Rooms
content: Zoom Rooms are conference rooms equipped with dedicated cameras and microphones. To start a meeting, tap the tablet on the conference table, enter your Zoom meeting ID, or join directly if the room was added to the Outlook invitation.

title: Requesting a New AWS Database Instance
content: To provision a new database instance on AWS (e.g., RDS PostgreSQL), submit an Infrastructure Request in Jira. Specify instance type, storage requirements, backup policies, network access lists, and whether the database is production or staging.

title: Hardware Security Keys (YubiKey) Usage
content: High-access employees (administrators, infrastructure engineers) are issued a physical YubiKey. Keep your YubiKey plugged in when performing administrative actions or deploying code to production. Report lost YubiKeys immediately to IT security.

title: Company Dress Code Policy
content: GlobalCorp has a 'Smart Casual' dress code. Business casual clothing is expected when meeting with clients, partners, or presenting at public events. Clothing with offensive language, explicit graphics, or torn fabrics is not permitted.

title: Submitting Feedback to Executive Leadership
content: To submit feedback, questions, or ideas directly to executive leadership, use the virtual feedback box on the intranet homepage. Submissions can be sent anonymously or with your name. Selected questions are answered by executives during Town Halls.

title: Understanding the Employee Referral Bonus Timeline
content: Referral bonuses are processed through payroll. The bonus is paid on the first payroll cycle following the referred employee's completion of 90 days of employment. Both you and the referred employee must be active employees at the time of payment.

title: IT Equipment Return Policy when Leaving
content: When leaving GlobalCorp, you must return all corporate-owned IT equipment (laptops, monitors, power supply bricks, security keys) on or before your last working day. Equipment can be dropped off at the IT desk or returned via prepaid shipping box.

title: Requesting Guest Speaker Approval
content: If you plan to invite an external guest speaker to present to your team or department, you must obtain approval from the Facilities and Security teams. Provide the speaker's name, company, topic, and expected number of internal attendees.

title: Annual Performance Appraisal Self-Assessment Guidelines
content: When writing your self-assessment, focus on your achievements relative to your quarterly OKRs. Use metrics and data where possible to demonstrate impact, and highlight areas where you would like to grow or receive additional training.

title: Standard Desktop Setup in Offices
content: Standard office desks are equipped with an adjustable desk arm, a 27-inch USB-C monitor, keyboard, mouse, and power strip. To connect your laptop, plug in the single USB-C cable which provides charging, external display, and wired network access.

title: Managing Cloud Cost Optimization
content: To minimize cloud expenditures, clean up unused resources, terminate idle EC2 instances, and delete detached EBS volumes weekly. Use AWS Cost Explorer to track your team's spending and look for recommendations for purchasing reserved instances.

title: Policy on External Business Activities
content: Employees must not engage in any external professional activities that conflict with the interests of GlobalCorp or use corporate resources for personal gain. Side jobs, freelance work, or consulting must be disclosed and approved by the Legal team.

title: Corporate Hotel Booking Guidelines
content: Always book corporate travel accommodations through our Travel Portal to secure negotiated rates. Ensure the nightly rate does not exceed the city cap. Upgrades to premium suites are at the employee's personal expense unless pre-approved.

title: Configuring Python Virtual Environments
content: To ensure development consistency, Python projects must utilize virtual environments. It is recommended to use `poetry` or `venv` to manage package dependencies. Avoid installing Python libraries globally to prevent package conflicts.

title: Submitting UI/UX Design Feedback
content: Design feedbacks should be organized directly inside Figma using comment threads. Clearly state the user flow step and suggest design improvements. For broader UX suggestions, present them in the weekly design-sync meeting.

title: Emergency Evacuation Muster Points
content: In case of fire alarms or safety evacuations, exit the building calmly. The designated assembly point is the North Parking Lot near Section B. Remain at the muster point until your department floor warden conducts a headcount.

title: Using Shared Department Printers
content: Connecting to department printers requires the printer hostname. In the system print dialog, add '\\print-srv-01\printer-name'. Tap your badge on the physical printer interface to release queued print jobs to maintain security.

title: Employee Pension Contribution Matching
content: GlobalCorp matches voluntary employee pension contributions dollar-for-dollar up to 5% of the gross salary. Employees can adjust their monthly contribution rates on the payroll portal under 'Retirement Benefits' before the 10th of every month.

title: Filing Expense Claims for Remote Work Utilities
content: Hybrid employees can claim up to $30 monthly to offset internet utility costs. Attach the PDF copy of your household utility statement clearly showing your name and billing address to the expense system under the 'Utilities' category.

title: Slack Custom Emoji Submission Guidelines
content: Custom emojis keep our workspace fun, but must adhere to workplace safety standards. Emojis containing offensive language, political slogans, or inappropriate imagery are subject to immediate removal by workspace administrators.

title: Standardizing API Error Responses
content: All backend APIs must adhere to the global JSON API specification. Errors should return standard HTTP status codes along with a JSON body containing unique error codes, descriptive developer messages, and arrays of user-friendly validation messages.

title: Requesting Access to the Source Code Repository
content: Access to corporate source code on GitHub is restricted. Submit an access request via the IT catalog stating your team name and the specific repositories required. Repository access requires prior approval from the engineering team lead.

title: Employee Gift and Hospitality Policy
content: Employees may not accept gifts, services, or hospitality from business partners or vendors exceeding a nominal value of $50. Any gift exceeding this threshold must be declared to the Compliance Team for evaluation of conflict of interest.

title: Requesting a New Slack Channel Creation
content: Before proposing a new public channel, verify if a similar channel already exists using Slack search. To request a channel, submit the online form with details of the channel name, purpose, visibility, and primary owner's email.

title: Accessing Corporate Training Portals
content: Employees can access virtual training courses via the corporate LMS portal. Log in with Single Sign-On to view assigned compliance courses, industry certifications, and leadership development paths curated by the HR learning team.

title: Standard Database Backup Restoration Process
content: Database backups are stored securely on AWS S3 with immutability enabled. To execute a restoration test in staging, locate the database instance snapshot ID in the RDS console, run the restore-db CLI command, and verify table schema consistency.

title: Setting Up Email Auto-Forwarding Rules
content: Auto-forwarding corporate emails to external personal accounts (e.g., Gmail, Yahoo) is strictly prohibited by security policies. Ensure your outlook rules do not contain redirect instructions to addresses outside our domain.

title: Submitting a Workplace Ergonomic Evaluation Request
content: To schedule a professional desk ergonomic assessment, go to the wellness portal, complete the physical self-evaluation form, and submit photos of your current workstation setup. A representative will contact you for a virtual review.

title: Managing Shared Server SSH Keys
content: Direct SSH password authentication is disabled on production servers. Administrators must register their authorized public key in the IAM system. Never copy, share, or store private keys on local drives or unencrypted folders.

title: Procedure for Reporting Lost Badge Access Cards
content: If you misplace your building access card, report it immediately to the security desk or submit an IT ticket. This ensures the card is deactivated instantly to prevent unauthorized entries. A replacement card costs $15.

title: Accessing Corporate Mobile Device Enrollment
content: Corporate phones and tablets must be enrolled in our Mobile Device Management (MDM) software. This enforces encryption, configures security certificates, and enables secure remote wipes in case the device is lost or stolen.

title: Requesting Staging Environment Deployment Permits
content: Deploying code to the shared staging environment is coordinated through the release manager. Submit your build details to the release channel at least 2 hours before deployment to avoid conflicts with ongoing automated testing suites.

title: Corporate Travel Cancellation Reimbursement Rules
content: If a business trip is canceled for business reasons, submit the cancellation fees as an expense report under 'Canceled Travel'. Include the formal written notice or email showing the trip cancel request from your manager.

title: How to Report Security Incidents Promptly
content: For immediate reporting of unauthorized physical entries, digital breaches, or compromised credentials, contact the Security Operations Center (SOC) hotline. Alternatively, send details to security-alert@globalcorp.com.

title: Guidelines on Workplace Political Activities
content: While employees are free to participate in political campaigns outside work hours, using company resources, computers, emails, or facilities for political campaigns, soliciting donations, or advertising is prohibited.

title: Requesting Docker Desktop Commercial Licenses
content: Docker Desktop requires a commercial license for enterprise use. Submit a software procurement ticket containing your project code. Once approved, the software licensing team will allocate an enterprise seat to your account.

title: Setting Up Git Commit Message Sign-offs
content: All code contributions must be signed off to verify ownership under the Developer Certificate of Origin. Append 'Signed-off-by: Name <email>' to all commits, or run git commit with the '-s' flag to generate it automatically.

title: Company Parking Space Assignment Rules
content: Parking slots in the basement are reserved primarily for executive officers and visitors. Standard parking permits are distributed via an annual lottery program. Unreserved outdoor parking is available to all staff on a first-come basis.

title: Understanding Salary Increment Cycles
content: Salary increments and cost of living adjustments are reviewed annually in April following the performance review cycle. Adjustments are decided based on performance rating, market benchmarks, and company profitability metrics.

title: Reporting Office Maintenance Issues Online
content: To report office cleaning requirements, plumbing issues, or broken lighting, open a ticket in the Office Facilities portal. Technicians will be assigned to resolve the maintenance request within 24 hours.

title: Corporate Stationery Procurement Policy
content: Standardized envelopes, business cards, and presentation folders must follow our branding. To order corporate stationery, consult the office procurement guidelines and submit your order details before the monthly ordering cutoff date.

title: Remote Employee Virtual Buddy Program
content: To ease remote onboarding, new remote hires are matched with a 'virtual buddy' from another team. Buddies schedule weekly casual coffee chats during the first month to share company culture, remote work tips, and team dynamics.

title: Applying for Training Course Tuition Assistance
content: Employees pursuing university degrees aligned with their career paths can apply for tuition assistance up to $3,000 annually. Submit your course details, university enrollment proof, and manager approval to the HR education team.

title: Creating a Professional Zoom Profile Avatar
content: For virtual client meetings, ensure your Zoom profile display picture is a professional, high-resolution headshot. Avoid using avatars, memes, or vacation photos as your profile picture to maintain corporate standards.

title: Accessing Internal Corporate Newsletter Archives
content: The internal communication team publishes 'The Global Pulse' newsletter monthly. To read previous editions, view company milestone announcements, or read employee spotlight features, visit the newsletter archive on the intranet.

title: Disaster Recovery Database Failover Procedure
content: If the primary database region suffers an outage, the system architect will initiate failover procedures. The standby database replica in the secondary region will be promoted to primary, and DNS records will update automatically via Route 53.

title: Office Desk Sharing and Hotdesking Rules
content: For hybrid employees, desks are assigned dynamically via our hotdesking app. Clear your desk of papers, mugs, and personal items at the end of your shift to ensure a clean desk for the next employee. Use lockers for storage.

title: Configuring Corporate Email on Mobile Devices
content: To sync Outlook email on your mobile device, install the official Outlook app. Log in using your credentials. You will be prompted to authenticate via Microsoft Authenticator and agree to corporate security data protection policies.

title: How to Report Workplace Bullying
content: GlobalCorp has zero tolerance for bullying or harassment. If you experience or witness hostile behavior, document the incidents and report them to HR via the secure reporting portal. All reports are investigated with complete confidentiality.

title: Requesting Access to the Corporate Analytics Dashboard
content: We use Tableau for business intelligence. To request access to sales, customer success, or product performance dashboards, submit a data analytics ticket specifying the dashboards required and get department lead approval.

title: Configuring Code Coverage Requirements
content: To maintain high software quality, code coverage thresholds are enforced at the repository level. Pull requests must maintain a minimum of 80% test coverage. Exceptions require approval from the principal engineering lead.

title: Submitting a Request for Security Badge Upgrades
content: Access to server rooms, research labs, or executive floors is restricted. To upgrade your security badge permissions, submit an access justification request approved by the facility head or physical security manager.

title: Corporate Policy on Digital Signature Validity
content: Legal agreements, vendor contracts, and internal sign-offs must be executed using DocuSign. Self-signed PDFs or image signatures are not legally recognized for official corporate transactions.

title: How to Set Up Slack Do Not Disturb (DND) Hours
content: To protect work-life balance, configure Slack DND hours. Navigate to Preferences -> Notifications -> Do Not Disturb. Set your working hours so Slack automatically mutes notifications outside this timeframe.

title: Applying for the Internal Mentorship Program
content: We run a bi-annual mentorship program matching junior employees with senior leaders. Applications open in January and July. To participate as a mentor or mentee, submit the application form with your career objectives.

title: Standard API Authentication Protocol
content: All internal microservices must authenticate communication using OAuth 2.0 with JSON Web Tokens (JWT). Client applications must request temporary tokens from our central auth server and include them in the HTTP Authorization header.

title: Filing Expense Claims for Client Dinners
content: Reimbursement for client dinners must be processed through Concur. Ensure you upload an itemized receipt listing all attendees, their company name, and include the meeting summary indicating the business discussion details.

title: Managing Shared Slack App Integrations
content: Installing third-party integrations or bots in corporate Slack workspaces is disabled by default. Submit integration requests to the Slack administration team. The tool must pass security review prior to deployment.

title: Software Vulnerability Mitigation Procedures
content: When a security scan identifies a vulnerability in your code, evaluate the CVE details immediately. Apply the recommended library patch, run regression tests in staging, and coordinate deployment to production with the DevOps team.

title: Office Kitchen Cleaning Schedule and Rules
content: Kitchen cleaning is managed by our facilities provider, but employees must clean up after themselves. Wash dirty dishes, wipe down microwaves after use, and label food items in refrigerators. Unlabeled items are discarded every Friday at 05:00 PM.

title: How to Request a New GitHub Repository
content: To create a new repository under our organization on GitHub, use the self-service IT portal. Specify the repository name, visibility, team members requiring admin access, and choose the template repository matching your programming language.

title: Corporate Relocation Policy Details
content: Relocation packages are provided for permanent transfers. Packages cover household packing services, flight arrangements for family members, and temporary lodging allowance for up to four weeks. Consult with Global Mobility for details.

title: Configuring Corporate Email Filters in Outlook
content: To keep your inbox organized, configure automatic email rules in Outlook. Right-click an email from a newsletter or automated alert system, select Rules -> Create Rule, and specify target folders to filter incoming traffic.

title: Understanding Employee Stock Vesting Schedules
content: Stock options are granted subject to a 4-year vesting schedule with a 12-month cliff. This means 25% of your shares vest on your first anniversary, with the remaining shares vesting in equal monthly increments over the next 36 months.

title: Requesting Virtual Sandbox Environments
content: Developers can request isolated virtual machine sandbox instances for software prototyping. Sandbox environments do not connect to production networks and are scheduled for automatic teardown every 14 days.

title: How to Submit Customer Escalation Tickets
content: When a customer reports a critical bug, create a P1 escalation ticket in Jira. Assign the ticket to the active duty support engineer, copy the client account manager, and update the internal Slack channel dedicated to support alerts.

title: Guidelines on Workplace Charity Fundraising
content: Charity fundraisers must be registered and approved by the corporate social responsibility (CSR) committee. The company will only match donations to charities registered under tax-exempt status in the employee's region.

title: Configuring Pre-Commit Hooks for Git
content: To prevent syntax issues and key exposures from reaching GitHub, configure pre-commit hooks. Use the `husky` package to run formatting checks and `git-secrets` to scan for credentials before committing changes.

title: Employee Parking Lot Security Measures
content: The employee parking garage is monitored 24/7 by CCTV cameras and patrol officers. For safety reasons, do not leave valuable items in plain view inside parked cars. Report suspicious activities in the parking lot to security immediately.

title: Submitting a Request for AWS IAM Permission Upgrades
content: Permanent AWS IAM role permissions are restricted. To request temporary or permanent permission upgrades, create an IAM ticket specifying the required policy permissions, the AWS resource ARNs, and manager validation.

title: Requesting a New Physical Office Locker
content: To request a physical locker for secure storage of your belongings, contact the floor facilities manager. Lockers are assigned based on availability and require your employee badge to lock and unlock.

title: Corporate Laptop Encryption Standards
content: All company-issued laptops are encrypted. Windows machines utilize BitLocker, and macOS machines utilize FileVault. Tampering with or disabling encryption settings violates our corporate security policies and will trigger an IT audit.

title: Scheduling Post-Mortem Incident Reviews
content: Following any major production outage (SEV-1), the engineering team lead must schedule a blameless post-mortem review within 48 hours. The goal is to identify root causes, document timelines, and outline actionable remediation tickets.

title: Accessing Corporate Remote Meeting Templates
content: When scheduling workshops or brain-storming sessions, access our Miro template gallery. We have standardized templates for product mapping, retrospective sessions, and sprint planning, which can be duplicated directly to your workspace.

title: Filing Expense Claims for Client Gifts
content: Corporate gifts for clients must be approved by the marketing team to ensure compliance with branding and anti-bribery policies. File gift expenses through Concur, attaching the approval email and purchase receipt.

title: Managing Staging Database Seeds
content: Staging databases are periodically seeded with mock data. Do not export production tables directly to staging databases to preserve user privacy. Use automated script migrations to generate simulated database entries.

title: Guidelines on Corporate Volunteer Time Off
content: Employees are eligible for two paid Volunteer Time Off (VTO) days per year. VTO activities must be coordinated with registered charities and approved by your direct manager to ensure team coverage.

title: Employee Sabbatical Leave Eligibility Rules
content: Permanent employees with five continuous years of service can request an unpaid sabbatical of up to 3 months. Applications must be submitted 6 months prior to the departure date to coordinate department work distribution.

title: How to Report Security Vulnerabilities in Our Code
content: If you identify a security vulnerability in any of our software systems, send a detailed report to security-reporting@globalcorp.com. Do not share the details publicly to prevent exploitation before a patch is deployed.

title: Acceptable Use Policy for Slack Channels
content: Slack is our primary communication tool and must remain professional. Refrain from using abusive language, sharing copyrighted files without authorization, or spamming non-work-related channels with external advertisements.

title: Requesting a New Jira Board Creation
content: To request a new Jira board for project tracking, submit a Jira support form. Provide the board name, team participants, and specify whether the board will use Scrum sprints or Kanban workflow styles.

title: Corporate Travel Meals Reimbursement Caps
content: Meals during corporate travel are reimbursed on an actual expense basis, capped at $75 per day. Itemized receipts are required for all transactions. Purchases of alcoholic beverages are excluded from reimbursement.

title: How to Register New Third-Party Vendors
content: Before onboarding a vendor, complete the Vendor Risk Assessment. Procurement and security must approve the vendor's data security practices before any contracts are executed by the legal department.

title: Accessing Internal Development Documentation
content: Software architecture blueprints, coding standards, and deployment pipelines are documented on our developer portal at devportal.globalcorp.com. Keep your local documentation updated and submit pull requests for any changes.

title: Corporate Desk Cleaning and Sanitization Standards
content: Office cleaning staff sanitize workstations nightly, but cleaning supplies are provided in common areas for personal use. Dispose of food containers in designated kitchen bins rather than desk trash cans to prevent odors.

title: How to Access and Print Paystubs
content: Monthly pay slips are accessible on the payroll service provider's website. Log in using your registered SSO account and go to the 'My Documents' section to view or download tax certificates and historical pay slips.

title: Understanding Salary Progression and Review Cycles
content: Compensation packages are reviewed annually. Adjustments are made based on the annual performance review score, industry compensation benchmarks, and budget allocations approved by executive leadership.

title: Reporting Office Facilities Faults
content: If you notice a facilities issue (e.g., broken escalators, air conditioning failure, faulty kitchen appliances), report it via the office portal. Urgent issues will be addressed by on-site maintenance within 1 hour.

title: Company Stationery Ordering Guidelines
content: Authorized letterheads, pens, envelopes, and business folders are ordered by the office administrator. To submit request items, fill in the quarterly stationery spreadsheet before the 15th day of the current quarter.

title: Employee Mentorship Program Registration Details
content: Our volunteer mentoring matches junior developers with senior architects. Matches are decided based on interests, technology stacks, and career paths. Submit your mentorship request form on the learning portal.

title: Applying for Tuition Assistance Support
content: Employees pursuing educational courses or university degrees related to their job profile can apply for tuition fee coverage. Submit course blueprints and financial receipts to the HR education team for review.

title: Zoom Background and Professional Display Rules
content: During public video conferences or virtual client workshops, use our official company virtual background. Neutral blurred backgrounds are acceptable if the corporate logo background is unavailable.

title: Weekly Corporate Newsletter Submissions
content: To publish team updates, product announcements, or social events in the weekly newsletter, email your content blocks to internal-communications@globalcorp.com by Tuesday at noon for editing.

title: Database Recovery and Testing Protocols
content: Database recovery scenarios must be validated quarterly. The DevOps team simulates system restoration from read-only cold storage backups to measure recovery times and ensure database state consistency.

title: Shared Desk Reservation and Guidelines
content: Desks are reserved dynamically via the desk planning application. If you change your remote work schedule, cancel your reservation to allow team members to utilize the space. Do not leave screens or office assets uncleaned.

title: Accessing Mobile Outlook App Profiles
content: When configuring corporate email on iOS or Android, the IT team requires the installation of the Mobile Device Management certificate. This ensures company data remains isolated and encrypted on personal devices.

title: Conflict of Interest Policy Overview
content: Employees must avoid situations where their private interests interfere with company obligations. Financial investments in major competitors, or hiring direct family members as external contractors, must be declared to HR.

title: Corporate Laptop Recovery and Backup Solutions
content: Laptop configurations are backed up to corporate OneDrive automatically. Do not save critical files locally outside synchronized folders to prevent data loss in the event of hardware failure or computer theft.

title: Requesting Access to the Corporate Tableau Platform
content: To view internal performance analytics, request a viewer seat on the Tableau database server. Permissions are managed based on employee role scopes, and access requests require your business unit leader's approval.

title: Code Review and Quality Guidelines
content: Pull requests should remain small to ensure detailed review. Code reviewers should verify style formatting, architecture patterns, and confirm code changes contain corresponding automated unit tests.

title: Requesting Building Access Keycards
content: Temporary badges are provided at security desks for employees who forget their credentials. To replace lost access badges, submit a replacement request form and pick up your card from security on the 1st floor.

title: Corporate Guidelines on Contract Signatures
content: Only authorized legal officers may sign external agreements or vendor contracts. Hand-signed agreements or scanned images are invalid; all official transactions must use approved DocuSign workflows.

title: Configuring Slack Channel Notifications
content: Manage Slack notifications to reduce distractions. Right-click high-traffic channels and customize alerts to 'Mentions Only' or mute channels that are not critical to your immediate projects.

title: Employee Mentorship Program Benefits
content: Participation in the mentoring program helps transfer technical knowledge and supports professional development. Mentors receive leadership training, and mentees gain guidance on technology stacks and project goals.

title: Standard REST API Design Specifications
content: All RESTful endpoints must utilize plural resource names and return payload schemas in JSON. Ensure that pagination, filtering, and standard resource error codes are implemented uniformly across microservices.

title: Travel Expense Claims Guidelines
content: Business travel expenses are reimbursed using Concur. Upload image copies of receipts and specify the project code associated with the trip. Submit claims within two weeks of returning from travel.

title: Setting Up Development IDE Code Linting
content: Enable code linting in your local IDE using the standard settings file provided in our developers repository. This guarantees uniform formatting and avoids formatting conflicts during Git code integrations.

title: Employee Health and Safety Training Rules
content: Annual fire safety and general workplace safety modules are mandatory for all office staff. Complete the assigned interactive safety training modules on the HR learning portal before the end of the fiscal year.

title: Corporate Gift Giving Restrictions
content: Giving corporate gifts to clients or vendors requires approval from the compliance officer. Gifts must be of nominal value, branded with the corporate logo, and registered in our public registry.

title: How to Join the Weekly Town Hall Meeting
content: The CEO updates staff every Thursday via Zoom on current priorities and metrics. Access the meeting link via Slack pinned announcements. Post and upvote questions anonymously in the Slido link provided.

title: Configuring Python Code Formatters locally
content: We standardize on Black and Isort for formatting Python code. Ensure these packages are configured in your development environment to automatically format your script on saving files.

title: Employee Training Budget Allocation Guidelines
content: Annual educational allowances of up to $1,000 can be spent on technical books, online courses, and external workshops. Submit the learning proposal details to your manager for approval prior to spending.

title: Corporate Email Signature Customization Generator
content: Generate your uniform email signature block using our intranet application. Input your title, phone number, and physical office location, then copy and paste the block directly into Outlook settings.

title: How to Handle Client Security Surveys

title: Ethical HR Harassment Reporting Pipelines
content: If you witness or experience bullying, report it immediately to your supervisor. Alternatively, file a secure report on the corporate ethics portal; all reports are investigated confidentially.

title: Requesting Tableau Viewer Permits
content: To request viewer access to the corporate analytics dashboards, submit an IT service catalog ticket. Access permits are approved based on department needs and require manager signature.

title: Software Code Change Peer Reviews
content: All software modifications require secondary reviews. Ensure your pull requests are small, follow coding standards, and contain valid unit test configurations before requesting code mergers.

title: Lost Badges Security Deactivation
content: If you lose your building keycard, notify security immediately. Security will deactivate your lost card and print a secure replacement keycard at the first-floor reception.

title: Legal Validations for Contract Agreements
content: All official agreements must be executed using DocuSign workflows. Do not submit handwritten scanned signatures or use third-party PDF signing applications for contract validations.

title: Custom Slack Alerts Setup Instructions
content: Set customized Slack alerts on your workspace profile to reduce noise. Configure keywords to trigger notifications only for specific project names or terms directly relevant to your daily tasks.

title: Mentorship Matching Application Guidelines
content: Our global mentoring program is open to all employees. To register, update your skills profile and mentorship goals on the intranet, and HR will connect you with a matching mentor.

title: Standard REST API Endpoint Specifications
content: All RESTful endpoints must utilize plural resource names and return payload schemas in JSON. Ensure that pagination, filtering, and standard resource error codes are implemented uniformly across microservices.

title: Submitting Claims for Business Travel Expenses
content: File travel expenses on Concur. Ensure you select the active project code and attach high-resolution images of receipts for transactions. Expense claims must be submitted in 14 days.

title: IDE Formatting Configuration Templates
content: Import our corporate code styling rules into your local IDE. Styling templates for various programming tools are available to download on the developer guidelines repository.

title: Office Emergency Marshal Locations
content: The list of designated floor fire wardens is posted near elevator lobbies. In the event of a fire alarm, locate your floor warden and follow evacuation instructions calmly.

title: How to Onboard External Consultants
content: Before onboarding a consultant, complete the security assessment form on the portal. Security must audit the consultant's infrastructure before legal signs any service agreements.

title: Viewing Devportal Platform System Logs
content: Developers can monitor system logs using Datadog. Log in using secure SSO and filter analytics logs using your microservice ID, target framework, and execution timestamp.

title: Clean Desk Hygiene Best Practices and Rules
content: Clear your personal work desk of food waste, mugs, and personal items every evening. Sanitizing wipes and sprays are stocked at printing stations to help clean desk surfaces.

title: How to Access PDF Payslips History
content: Access historical pay statements inside the payroll portal. Authenticate with SSO, select 'Payslips History', and download PDF documents directly for your tax filing requirements.

title: Understanding Annual Pay Adjustment Cycles
content: Yearly compensation packages are evaluated based on performance reviews and company results. Promotions, bonus allocations, and salary increases are discussed during review cycles.

title: Reporting Office Facilities Repair Requests
content: To report physical office problems, open a repair ticket on the Facilities system. Specify the issue type, floor number, and room name so our on-site team can find and repair the defect quickly.

title: Corporate Office Stationery Procurement Processes
content: Office admins order standard stationery items weekly. For specialized folders or customized name cards, fill out the procurement order spreadsheet on the intranet portal prior to monthly deadlines.

title: New Hire Buddy Onboarding Program
content: To help new colleagues adjust during their first week, team buddy partners are assigned. Buddies introduce team members to tools, coordinate casual team lunches, and explain office navigation.

title: How to Request Tuition Reimbursement Support
content: To request financial aid for educational courses, submit your target syllabus and manager validation to HR. Tuition costs are reimbursed upon successful completion of the course.

title: Zoom Video Profile Avatar Standards
content: Ensure your video conference avatar is a professional, high-resolution photo. Do not utilize cartoons, memes, or vacation images as profile pictures to preserve corporate image.

title: Public Communications Release Policies
content: All public media announcements, product release notices, and press statements must be reviewed by the communications lead. Employees must not distribute company statements or comments directly to media.

title: Database Schema Change Validation Procedures
content: Proposed database schema changes must be submitted via Confluence. Include migration scripts, estimate database execution impact, and verify migrations with backend engineering teams.

title: Hotdesking Desk Cleaning Policies and Guidelines
content: Remove cups, tissues, and waste from your workspace before leaving. Use sanitizing wipes located near printing locations to clean desk surfaces before and after use.
